payload.title: M2 First data feature: precedential TTAB decisions over time
payload.description: A live chart on a /data/ page: TTAB decisions and precedential designations per year (first count: about 50 precedential a year through 2023, 33 in 2024, 15 in 2025, 10 in 2026 to about Oct. 8). De-duplicate and reconcile counts before publishing. Needs a reusable data-feature component in the Papyrus standard front end (a JSON file refreshed by the backend, rendered by a chart component), plus an accompanying story.
